_readme: The paintings Sierra's landing cycles through (Sam, 2026-10-08: "Maybe we cycle through our First Light plein air artwork like America.gov cycles through pics of americana"). California works from First Light's set (first_light.js), each public domain on Wikimedia Commons. scripts/fetch_sierra_art.py, run by .github/workflows/sierra-art-fetch.yml on a runner (the session cannot reach Commons), writes <slug>-1600.webp and <slug>-800.webp beside this file, so the public page loads nothing from a third party. focal is the CSS object-position that keeps the subject in a phone's crop.
